nom: COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Power Sheet Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report strong hydration and relief from dryness, dullness, and in one case redness and itchiness, with no irritation mentioned by this group.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and good soothing, but others report burning or sensitizing reactions, one attributed to tea tree oil in the formula.
segments.combination: One reviewer without dry skin still found the mask plumping and nourishing overnight.

concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe visible, fast hydration and plumping, including glass-skin or glowing effects the morning after use; this is the most consistently praised benefit.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says the mask calmed pre-existing redness and itchiness; another reports the mask itself caused burning and sensitization, tied to tea tree oil in the ingredient list.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the mask with repairing a moisture barrier damaged by another product after just one to two uses.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report improvement or no new breakouts, but two describe significant new breakouts or worsening acne lasting weeks after use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers describe the leftover serum as excessively slimy or shiny on the skin, though this is about product residue rather than the skin's own oil production.

extraits.titre: Never had acne like this before
extraits.texte: I was excited for these face masks because I love the snail mucin essence. At first i loved it it felt nice and hydrating. Then immediately after i got a HUGE breakout and I AM NOT USUALLY ACNE PRONE. I SOMETIMES get ONE pimple that goes away after a week. I have never had acne like this EVER. I had a breakout all over my face that has now been here for 2 months. I thought it was something else, but when i tried the face mask again my acne got worse, and it started the first time I used it.

Very disappointed that this has tea tree oil in it. I didnt check the label because i use many cosrx products and i trust them. I noticed my face burning very quickly after putting the mask on. I checked the ingredient list to find out it has tea tree oil. I dont understand why. That is such a highly sensitizing ingredient. Such a shame because my skin actually looked a looked a lot better when i took it off but my skin just felt so sensitized.

I had tried the viral collagen mask by Sungboon a few times at decreasing time durations and every time it destroyed my skin. The skin around my mouth, chin and jaw broke out in all these little bumps, I developed acne, I was dry and raw. This mask saved me. After just one use I noticed an improvement. After two uses, my skin feels mostly repaired. My skin feels so good and moisturized, I can't even express how grateful I am to this product. There's a lot of juice left in the packet after using the mask too, so I'm able to do multiple applications. No amount of moisturizer or hydrating oils were able to do what this mask did for me in two uses. It was gentle enough to not further harm my damaged skin, yet nourishing enough to repair it. The price point is reasonable too. I will be keeping this mask on hand always.

when I first got this product it made my skin really smooth. I liked that it had no smell and it was great for my sensitive skin. After just three uses my acne and just texture overall on my face had gotten better. This is a need especially when it is paired with the essence you will literally have baby smooth skin!!!
My skin is very dry and sensitive. These sheet masks hydrate my skin without any irritation.
Such a hydrating mask for my dry, dull, and acne prone skin. Absolutely love this brand
This stuff saved my dry, red, itchy skin and i'm now going to buy a bottle!
